Name: Watermill Expanded
Author: Ex0dus
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49743/49743-1792116847-1654617959.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40403]yuninocorn's Watermill [/url]is a building that my wife and I love but it always made us a bit sad that we could not use it like a normal mill. My wife also wanted there to be a use for the paper that the watermill produces so we came up with over 20 artisan goods to make out of the 3 types of paper made in yuninocorn's mod![/size]


[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49743/49743-1792116852-873416858.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][size=3]Full mill functionality for the Watermill (rice, wheat, beets, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia items[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]Chicken Feed[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50830]Rice Expansion[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54820]Glassworks[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39216]Cloths and Colors[/url] fully supported)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Crafting menu recipes added if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25467]Si's Extra Crafting Materials[/url] is installed to convert between the paper in this mod and that mod[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]26 different artisan good recipes made from paper and 1 new machine to process them[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Some items have seasonal or other variants (Giftwrap, Piñatas, Paper Flowers, Maple Figurine, Slime Rancher Figurines)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]58 new items altogether; plus an additional 18 cross-over items with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49743?tab=description]Chocobo Valley Remixed[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Android compatible (Extra Machine Configs requirement is 1.6.0, which is compatible with Android)[/size][/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50640/50640-1793759672-2055000218.png[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]Variants List:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Giftwrap -> Make giftwrap in winter
Piñata -> Two variants per season, one in the first half and one in the second half (8 variants total)
Paper Flower -> Day of week (Sunday, Monday, etc.) + even or odd day (14 variants total)
Slime Rancher Figurine -> Day of week (Sunday, Monday, etc.)
Dodo Figurine -> Even and odd weeks
Swan Figurine -> First and second half of the season
Maple the Bunny Figurine-> Seasonal[/spoiler]
